newsitem.title: USA: West Coast agrees to buy Australian chain.
newsitem.headline: West Coast agrees to buy Australian chain.

text.p: West Coast Entertainment Corp said early Wednesday that it has a definitive asset purchase agreement with the 108-store Movieland chain of Australia.

The company said the acquisition marks its entry into the Australian marketplace. Movieland's stores are in four Australian states -- Victoria, New South Wales, South Australia and Western Australia, the company said.
West Coast said closing on the deal depends on the successful completion of certain financial transactions.
